target: Spoiler-free completion of all directed-story routes, outcomes, rewards, and finite Classic-mode systems

areas.name: Original PC or Mac Route
areas.location_cue: The original launcher, story selector, free-play selector, save folders, and graphics options.
areas.note: Chosen route: the original standalone Windows or Mac release; no secondary platform or later definitive edition exists.

save_backup.title: Create a clean backup first
save_backup.why: Directed-story rewards and the outcome branch are stored in the game’s save data.
save_backup.detail: Copy the complete save folder before directed play and keep another checkpoint before the outcome prompt.

levels.1: Confirm the standalone Stories game rather than a similarly named Sims 2 package.
levels.2: Install the original Windows or Mac release and open its story selector.
levels.3: Launch the game, create a disposable free-play household, verify every story tile and Classic mode appear, then preserve the untouched save folder.

levels.1: An additional directed route becomes available after required progress elsewhere.
levels.2: Record every story tile, its lock state, and the free-play option.
levels.3: Open the selector and record all current tiles, return after completing the required available route, and confirm every directed-story tile can be started.

levels.1: Story triggers depend on the original objects, lots, and scripted households.
levels.2: Remove gameplay mods before beginning directed play.
levels.3: Use a clean user folder, retain only compatibility settings that do not alter goals, and test the first marker before committing the permanent save.

areas.name: Four Corners Home Goals
areas.location_cue: The starting residence, its kitchen, wardrobe, mirrors, computer, phone, dining area, bedroom, and front path.
areas.note: Use these entries only when the active marker points to the home lot; story details are intentionally withheld.

levels.1: Follow the active marker and prepare motives before starting its chained interactions.
levels.2: Complete every current goal around the starting home.
levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: give the marked Sim a friendly hug; eat a meal from the refrigerator; plan an Everyday outfit at a wardrobe; change appearance at a mirror; greet all visitors; use Play, then Tickle.  Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

levels.1: Follow the active marker and prepare motives before starting its chained interactions.

Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

levels.1: Follow the active marker and prepare motives before starting its chained interactions.

levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: use Charm; use Tender Kiss; use Make Out.  Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

levels.1: Follow the active marker and prepare motives before starting its chained interactions.

levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: invite marked contact; raise the unseen partner-side relationship to 51; use phone conversations before retrying a refused invitation.  Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

levels.1: Follow the active marker and prepare motives before starting its chained interactions.

levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: use Talk, then Chat with the marked household member; call the marked adviser and choose Talk.  Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

areas.location_cue: Starlight Cafe and Market, Old Grove Park, Lead’s Gym, The Corner Boutique, and Old Grove Gardens.

save_backup.title: Save before each community visit
save_backup.why: The directed route cannot be saved while a community-lot goal chain is active.
save_backup.detail: Save at home, fill motives, then travel and remain until the return prompt appears.

levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: call the marked adviser and choose Talk; invite marked contact; take a taxi to the cafe; practice chess and ask the marked Sim to join; request a table and order a meal; use First Kiss; wait for the directed return prompt. Risk: community lots cannot save. Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: invite the marked contact to the gym; gain one Body skill point on a treadmill; enter hot tub; ask the marked contact to join; leave after prompt.  Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: call the marked contact and choose Talk only; taxi to boutique; try two outfits; use Attack; spend at least §2,000 on clothing; leave after prompt.  Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

areas.name: Four Corners Directed-Story Finish
areas.location_cue: The starting residence, its bedroom, buy catalog, phone, party spaces, and story-reward panel.
areas.note: The wording describes only controls and completion conditions, not the surrounding story.

save_backup.title: Back up before the concluding home goals
save_backup.why: Completing the concluding marked chain ends directed play and changes the neighborhood to open-ended play.
save_backup.detail: Copy the save before the current marker advances into its household milestone and party tasks.

point_of_no_return.title: Directed goals conclude here
point_of_no_return.why: Finishing the requested party closes this story’s guided objective sequence.
point_of_no_return.detail: Confirm all earlier reward-panel slots from this route before completing the party.

levels.1: Follow the active marker and prepare motives before starting its chained interactions.
levels.2: Complete every current goal around the starting home.
levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: use the marked relationship action on the bed; repeat it until the confirmation chime plays; buy four requested nursery objects; wait until the active goal advances; invite at least three non-family friends; raise the party rating to Good Time.  Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

levels.1: The selector changes after enough goals in the available route are complete.
levels.2: Return to the main selector after finishing the Four Corners route.
levels.3: Complete the current directed sequence, allow its completion summary to finish, return to the selector, and verify the previously locked story can now be started.

areas.name: Bitville Outcome Branch
areas.location_cue: The starting residence, outdoor telescope area, household portraits, outcome prompt, and story-reward panel.
areas.note: Every mechanical outcome is required; the story context and identities are deliberately withheld.

save_backup.title: Make a separate save before the outcome prompt
save_backup.why: The decision changes the household state, and only one branch awards the statue.
save_backup.detail: Keep the checkpoint untouched until every branch has been recorded.

point_of_no_return.title: Outcome branch ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Confirming either option ends the directed sequence and commits that branch’s household state.
point_of_no_return.detail: Do not overwrite the pre-prompt checkpoint.

levels.1: Follow the active marker and prepare motives before starting its chained interactions.
levels.2: Complete every current goal around the starting residence.
levels.3: Keep motives stable and follow the active marker in this order: practice guitar; take shower; greet arriving contact; watch television for one in-game hour; lead the marked Sim to the telescope; practice guitar while the guest watches; propose Move In; have both household members stargaze outdoors; resolve the displayed outcome prompt. Stop before resolving the outcome branch and make a separate save. Do not leave the lot until the next goal or return prompt appears.

levels.1: One option preserves assets and adds an exclusive story reward.
levels.2: At the outcome prompt, choose the asset-preserving option first.
levels.3: Load the pre-prompt save, complete the marked outdoor actions, choose the option that retains the household’s assets, finish the summary, and verify the statue appears in Story Rewards.

levels.1: Restore the untouched checkpoint after confirming the reward branch.
levels.2: Select the relationship-preserving option on the restored branch.
levels.3: Reload the save made before the prompt, repeat the marked interaction, choose the option that preserves the relationship instead of the assets, and retain a separate post-choice save.

levels.1: The directed goals and one outcome branch populate a separate object panel.
levels.2: Verify every Bitville reward slot, including the branch statue.
levels.3: NEEDS_VERIFICATION

areas.name: Classic Mode Aspirations and Lifecycle
areas.location_cue: The free-play selector, Create-a-Sim, wants and fears panel, aspiration meter, relationship panel, date and outing meters, and household family tree.
areas.note: Classic mode is open-ended, so the pack uses finite aspirations, social meters, rewards, and life stages as its auditable boundary.

save_backup.title: Back up before reward experiments
save_backup.why: Low aspiration states can make powerful reward objects fail.
save_backup.detail: Use a disposable branch for negative outcomes and retain a clean platinum household.

levels.1: Use a dedicated free-play Sim so its wants can be followed consistently.
levels.2: Reach permanent platinum with a Family Sim.
levels.3: Create or select a Sim with the Family aspiration, fulfill its wants, avoid major fears, complete a matching Lifetime Want, and retain the resulting permanent platinum state.

levels.1: Compatible partners and fulfilled wants raise the shared meter.
levels.2: Finish a free-play date at its highest tier.
levels.3: Invite a compatible partner to a well-equipped lot, fulfill wants for both Sims, avoid rejected interactions and fears, and end only after the date meter reaches its top rating.

levels.1: Shared activities keep every group member involved.
levels.2: Finish a group outing at its highest tier.
levels.3: Form a group, travel to a community lot, rotate through activities everyone can use, satisfy social wants, and continue until the outing meter reaches its top rating.

levels.1: Aspiration, personality, and attraction settings combine into chemistry.
levels.2: Make one pair display three chemistry bolts.
levels.3: Choose compatible aspirations and personalities, adjust turn-ons and turn-offs, use the room-scoping interaction, and refine the pair until three bolts appear.

levels.1: Classic mode remains open after the directed stories end.
levels.2: Raise one household through every available life stage.
levels.3: Create a household, preserve its family tree, satisfy age-specific needs and milestones, use safe birthdays, and continue until every available life stage has been played.

levels.1: High aspiration points open a finite reward catalog.
levels.2: Place and successfully test every aspiration-reward object.
levels.3: Build points on specialist Sims, buy each reward while their aspiration state is safely high, perform its main interaction, and record the result on a backed-up lot.
